verdicts.reason: A has a real layout, but the can is broken. It is blown up with no fill, so it reads as an empty outline, and its cream circle is cut off alone in the bottom-left corner. The headline is small for this canvas, the copy has big gaps between lines, and NEW floats on its own. B keeps the brand intact, but it is just the original strip placed across the middle. Big empty bands sit above and below it, and the logo circle and CTA press against the side edges, so it does not fit the format at all.
